name: redmine
description: 耐德科技 Redmine（redmine.nineder.com）技能組：/redmine 查詢建立更新議題、redmine-feature Feature 需求撰寫規範、/redmine-feature-create 互動式建立 Feature 需求單、/redmine-bug Bug 撰寫規範、/redmine-bug-create 互動式建立 Bug 單。另含 UserPromptSubmit hook：訊息含議題編號或公司 GitLab repo 短路徑時，自動注入連結對照與 session 改名提醒（設 REDMINE_ISSUE_CONTEXT=0 停用）。規格議題：#26309/#26311/#26312/#26313/#26314/#26315/#26559/#26851
